native_primitives_scope: Native object primitives: distinct resident Entry addresses derive cardinality bounds; disjoint occupied Arc<Node> payload and Box<Branch> regions survive allocation, same-shape writes, branch-to-leaf conversion and justified reclamation. Explicit per-child retained Arc tokens support arbitrary snapshot-release interleavings during COW. Successful payload allocation moves those tokens into edges; assignment and interleaved old-token teardown preserve the copied value, unique fresh root, saved roots and object-region invariants. The no-Weak Arc behavior is an explicit pinned library/compiler contract. This does not establish all Rust/native layouts, buffers, mutation places, physical word loops or full algorithm extraction.
